title: Associate Data Engineer (W)
description:
Position: Associate Data Engineer

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Undergo structured training in modern data engineering tools, technologies, and best practices
  2. Collaborate with senior engineers on the design and development of data pipelines and processing systems
  3. Work with real-world datasets and cloud-based platforms to gain practical, hands-on experience

Requirements

  1. Recent B.Tech graduates in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Electronics & Communication
  2. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  3. Basic programming knowledge (Python, SQL, or similar)
  4. Ability to work from our Pune office during the training period
  5. Available to join immediately

Benefits

  • Private Health Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Work From Home (Post 3~6 months of training in Pune office)
  • Training & Development

title: Associate Project Manager
description:

This role is ideal for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who is eager to learn project management fundamentals and grow within a collaborative fast-paced professional environment.

This is a hybrid position requiring in-office attendance at the Whiteville, North Carolina office at least three (3) days per week to collaborate with project stakeholders and internal teams.
